label: Terrain
help: Edit the source of this finite heightfield with Edit Terrain.

properties.label: Shape
properties.help: Controls the shape of the elevation profile.

properties.label: Seed
properties.help: Reproduces a variation of the same shape.

properties.label: Width
properties.help: Extent along the local X axis.

properties.label: Depth
properties.help: Extent along the local Z axis.

properties.label: Minimum elevation
properties.help: Lower bound relative to the entity origin.

properties.label: Maximum elevation
properties.help: Upper bound relative to the entity origin.

properties.label: Feature size
properties.help: Approximate size of the largest hills or ridges.

properties.label: Samples per side
properties.help: More samples give finer mesh detail.
